title: Notify=healthy: READY lost when the sending podman process exits before systemd reads it
body:
### Issue Description

After a reboot, one of my rootless Quadlet containers with `Notify=healthy` stayed in `activating` until `TimeoutStartSec` (10 min), although the container was healthy after 15 s. systemd then killed and restarted it, and the second start worked. It happened once in seven boots, on a host where eleven user managers start at the same time.

`waitForHealthy` sends `READY=1` from the inner podman process, which exits right after. systemd attributes a notification to a unit by the cgroup of its sender when it reads the message. If the sender is already gone, it drops the message with a debug-only log line. sd_notify(3) describes this case and recommends `sd_notify_barrier()`. `notifyproxy.SendMessage` doesn't send a barrier.

### Steps to reproduce the issue

The race depends on timing. Stopping the user manager briefly makes it deterministic:

```sh
MGR=$(pgrep -u "$(id -u)" -f "^/usr/lib/systemd/systemd --user")
systemd-analyze --user log-level debug
systemd-run --user --unit=notify-race -p Type=notify -p NotifyAccess=all -p TimeoutStartSec=8 \
  sh -c "(sleep 1; kill -STOP $MGR; systemd-notify --ready --no-block; sleep 0.5; kill -CONT $MGR) & exec sleep 30"
journalctl --user -g "notify-race|Cannot find unit for notify"
```

I built a small binary that calls `notifyproxy.SendMessage("", "READY=1")` and ran it in place of `systemd-notify` in the same setup: the unit times out with current main.

### Describe the results you received

```
systemd[...]: Cannot find unit for notify message of PID 174952, ignoring.
systemd[...]: notify-race.service: start operation timed out. Terminating.
```

From the boot:

```
06:15:38 podman: container health_status ... name=proxy-crowdsec, health_status=healthy
06:25:21 systemd[1031]: crowdsec.service: start operation timed out. Terminating.
```

### Describe the results you expected

The unit becomes active once the container is healthy.

### Podman in a container

No

### Privileged Or Rootless

Rootless

### Upstream Latest Release

No

### Additional environment details

openSUSE MicroOS, kernel 7.2.11, systemd 261.3, Quadlet user units with `Notify=healthy`. 6.1.2, but `SendMessage` is unchanged on main.

### Additional information

The same applies to every message `SendMessage` sends: MAINPID/READY for `--sdnotify=conmon` and the READY of `kube play`. While testing I also found that the proxy's listener parses `oob` instead of `oob[:oobn]`, so it never closes the barrier fds it receives. I have a fix for both and will open a PR.
